subject: Re: Close runbook — MAP checkpoints, pricing path & final CDW
messages:
From: Sarah Choi <sarah.choi@nimbus.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Long <peter.long@nimbus.com>, procurement@nimbus.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft and timing — request for checkpoint-linked pricing

Mina / team,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Nimbus leadership has reviewed the evaluation plan and they want to lock the MAP timeline before legal drops the PO. Two asks from procurement: 1) can pricing be expressed as milestone-linked credits (to align with our internal cost recognition)? and 2) we need a clearer commit/ramp schedule tied to the checkpoints — if you can map discounts to successful checkpoint signoffs, procurement can provision spend earlier.

I've attached our internal acceptance checklist for reference. Can you share a version of the MAP that includes the pricing slab for each checkpoint and an updated SOW timeline?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Choi
Head of Platform Strategy, Nimbus Systems
[Attachment: Nimbus_Acceptance_Checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Choi <sarah.choi@nimbus.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timing — request for checkpoint-linked pricing

Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. Attached: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (proposed MAP with milestone definitions, acceptance criteria, and the pricing slab per checkpoint) and a first-pass SOW (SOW_Nimbus_draft_20260211.pdf). High level summary:

- Evaluation window: 60 days from kickoff (Week 0 = initial environment access)
- Checkpoints: Gate 1 (P0 integration + perf baseline), Gate 2 (feature parity + map tests), Gate 3 (scale run & SLA signoff)
- Pricing path: initial evaluation credits applied up to Gate 2; committed discount tiers kick in after Gate 3 on a 12-month committed capacity.
- Proposed concession: a 10% trial credit applied pro rata at Gate 2 signoff if Nimbus accepts the SOW within 10 business days.

Rishi / Marissa — can you review the concession and confirm approval for the Gate 2 trial credit? If we greenlight, I'll incorporate into the SOW and send the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timing — request for checkpoint-linked pricing

Quick note — I support the Gate 2 trial credit but want it scoped: it should only apply to usage consumed during the evaluation cluster (not production traffic). Recommend limiting the credit to $60k cap and requiring a signed SOW to release funds. Also suggest we add the following fallback: if Gate 3 is delayed more than 30 days, the credit auto-converts to a one-time invoice credit applied against the first month of committed capacity.

Marissa — can you OK the cap and fallback? If yes I’ll mark the concession approved and Mina can finalize.

-Rishi
Principal Sales Director, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timing — request for checkpoint-linked pricing

Rishi — OK to proceed with your recommendation. Approve the Gate 2 trial credit with the following constraints:
- Credit cap $60,000; evaluation cluster usage only (per request)
- Credit released on receipt of signed SOW and kickoff meeting minutes (evidence required)
- If Gate 3 slips > 30 days, convert to invoice credit against month-1 committed bill
- Approve an extra 5% ramp discount at Gate 3 if Nimbus commits to 12-month capacity >= 2x their evaluation peak.

Mina — incorporate the constraints into the MAP and SOW. After you send the DocuSign link, loop legal if Nimbus requests additional contracting language.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Choi <sarah.choi@nimbus.com>
Cc: Peter Long <peter.long@nimbus.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@nimbus.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timing — request for checkpoint-linked pricing

Sarah — appreciate the patience. Attached are the updated MAP (Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a redlined SOW (SOW_Nimbus_draft_20260218.pdf) that reflect internal approvals. Key points:

- Gate 2 trial credit: $60,000 cap, evaluation-cluster-only, released after signed SOW and kickoff minutes.
- Gate 3 ramp incentive: additional 5% discount on committed unit price when 12-month commit >= 2x evaluation peak.
- Timeline: we propose kickoff 2 Mar 2026; Gate 1 = 2 weeks, Gate 2 = +4 weeks, Gate 3 = +4 weeks (60-day eval).

Next steps: Please sign the attached SOW (DocuSign link below) by 26 Feb to qualify for the Gate 2 credit. Once signed we’ll provision the eval cluster and schedule the kickoff.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/r/ABC123-nimbus-sign
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/DEAL-2026-0587

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the redlines.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Nimbus_draft_20260218.pdf (redline pdf)]
